image_description: A close-up view of the wheelhouse and bow area of a fireboat on the water. The boat has a red and white color scheme with a prominent red water cannon (monitor nozzle) mounted on the bow. The wheelhouse has large windows and a red roof. Various equipment including lights, speakers, and antennas are mounted on top of the wheelhouse. The sea is visible in the background with some wake, indicating the boat is moving.
